name: boltzgen_submit_design
description: Submit a BoltzGen generative binder design or redesign job to Vertex AI Pipelines. Supports 6 protocols: protein-anything, peptide-anything, protein-small_molecule, nanobody-anything, antibody-anything, and protein-redesign. Accepts raw BoltzGen YAML or structured target inputs (RCSB PDB ID, GCS URI, or local file).

input.description: Input specification in BoltzGen YAML format, raw query YAML, or path to input file. If target_structure is provided, input can be omitted or used as raw YAML override.

target_structure.description: Target structure identifier: 4-letter RCSB PDB ID (e.g. '6M1U'), GCS URI (gs://bucket/path.cif or .pdb), or local file path.

target_chains.description: Target protein chains to bind against (e.g. ['A'] or ['A', 'B']).

binding_residues.description: Target hotspot/interface residues in 'Chain:ResNum' or 'ResNum' format (e.g. ['A:23', 'A:24', 'A:27'] or ['23', '24']).

binder_length_range.description: Length range for designed binder protein/peptide, e.g. '80..140' or '15..30' (default: '80..140').

ligand_smiles.description: SMILES string for small molecule ligand target or co-factor (for protein-small_molecule protocol).

ligand_ccd.description: 3-letter Chemical Component Dictionary (CCD) code for ligand.

num_model_seeds.description: Number of model seeds for parallel fan-out (default: 5). Each seed explores distinct diffusion and sequence space.

num_designs_per_seed.description: Number of final ranked designs to generate per seed (default: 2).

gpu_type.description: GPU type: 'auto' (default, A100 for <=1500 tokens, A100_80GB for >1500), 'A100', or 'A100_80GB'.

enable_flex_start.description: Enable DWS FLEX_START scheduling to queue job when GPUs unavailable (default: true)

name: boltzgen_analyze_parallel
description: Trigger parallel analysis of BoltzGen design results via Cloud Run Jobs. Evaluates self-consistency (sc_score), clash_score, pLDDT, ipTM, and generates Gemini expert analysis.

name: boltzgen_get_analysis_results
description: Retrieve BoltzGen analysis results from Cloud Run. Returns sc_score, clash_score, ranking_score, ipTM, pLDDT, designed sequences, and Gemini expert analysis.

name: boltzgen_open_viewer
description: Open the FoldRun 3D structure viewer for BoltzGen designed complexes. Shows CIF structure with pLDDT coloring, interface hotspots, ranking metrics, and analysis plots.

open_browser.description: Open viewer URL directly in browser (default: true)
